itemList.description: Providing and fixing M.S. grills of required pattern in frames of windows etc. with M.S. flats, square or round bars etc. including priming coat with approved steel primer all complete. Fixed to openings /wooden frames with rawl plugs screws etc

Painting Steel work with Deluxe Multi Surface Paint to give an even shade. Two coat applied @ 0.90 ltr/10 m² over an under coat of primer applied @ 0.80 ltr/10 m² of approved brand and manufacture including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge

Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of Audio Amplifier with built-in Mixer, Class-AB type, having 500-550 W RMS power output per channel, single output channel, suitable for 4 2/8 2 nominal impedance, with 70 V and 100 V speaker taps, frequency response approximately 50 Hz-15 kHz, minimum S/N ratio 60-70 dB, maximum THD not exceeding 10%, provided with minimum 2 nos. 1/4" TS line inputs, 2 nos. 1/4" TS auxiliary inputs and 2 nos. RCA auxiliary inputs, barrier-strip speaker outputs, metal cabinet construction, suitable for 230 V 10%, 50 Hz AC supply, rated power consumption approximately 1500-1600 W, complete with all standard accessories, interconnections, installation, testing and commissioning, conforming to the specified GeM technical specifications and complete in all respects. (Hoduct Id-5116877-45821937069)

Providing, supplying, installing, testing and commissioning of professional wired handheld dynamic microphone, cardioid/unidirectional type, with dynamic transducer, frequency response of approximately 40 Hz to 15-18 kHz, sensitivity 2-6 mV/Pa, signal-to-noise ratio 90-110 dB, complete with XLR connector, 7-10 m long cable, metal body/casing, ON/OFF switch, and all necessary accessories, connections and fittings, complete in all respects as per the specified technical requirements, including testing and commissioning,conforming to the specified GeM technical specifications and complete in all respects.

Providing, supplying, installing, testing and commissioning of 250 500 W RMS passive PA speaker, floor standing type, having 2 drivers, nominal impedance 8 2 frequency response of approximately 40 Hz to 15 20 kHz, sensitivity 80 100 dB, horizontal coverage 80 100 and vertical coverage 80 110, complete with wooden cabinet, black finish, screw on barrier strip/1/4" TS speaker input connector and pluggable terminal block output connector, including all necessary accessories, mounting/supports, interconnections, testing and commissioning

Auditorium Chair : (Medium range) Supply and installation of floor/ Raiser Mounted seating system comprising common upright support assemblies of high strength steel construction and powder coated finish, Synchronous movement of back and base known as scissor mechanism (Black Powder coated) with Auto tip up Mechanism and with fire retardant fabric pasted with P.U foam upholstered,130 mm+/- 10mm thick back cushion (pipe frame embedded to moulded PU Foam, Density 50+/- 5 kg/ m3 and foam hardness 20+/-5) having erogonomic design, 150+/-10 mm thick seat cushion (pipe frame embedded to moulded PU Foam, having ply at the underside & covered with PP, density 50+/-5kg/m3 and foam hardness 20+/-5) and with the seating assembly having overall height of 1020+/- 10mm, Width of 562+/-10 mm and Depth of 700+/-10 mm, intermiediary armrest with cupholder, height from seat 230 mm, handle in of 440 mm and handle out of 620 mm and floor to seat height of 485+/-10 mm. Side panel shall be metalic structure made of HRCA sheet of 1.6 mm thickness, fastened with mechanism, black powder coated with height of 555mm, width of 125mm and depth of 395 mm. Chairs to be installed as per architect approved seatig layout, complete including all hardware and row/seat number plate accessories as required and to be fitted at site as per direction of engineer incharge

Providing supplying installing testing and commissioning of 600 mm size wall mounted oscillating air circulator fan complete with 3 blades capacitor type induction motor minimum 2 speed operation minimum 5 m flexible cord protective guard and speed regulator having minimum air delivery of 250 Sqm min, maximum power input of 200 W suitable for single phase 230 V 50 Hz AC supply, with automatic continuous directional oscillation, ventilated motor enclosure and Class E winding insulation, conforming to IS 2997 complete with all necessary accessories supports electrical connections testing and commissioning, including all labour and materials, complete in all respects conforming to the specified GeM technical specifications and complete in all respects.

Wiring for lighting /power circuitusing one of FRLSPV Cinsulated 1100Vgrade, multistr and copper wire with low conductor resistance single corein openor concealed system of wiring with specified IS-694:2010 1.5 mm2

Providing & fixing factory made PVC Door frame of size 50x47mm with a wall thickness of 5mm, made out of extruded 5mm rigid PVC foam sheet metered cut at corners & jointed 2 No.s of 150mm long brackets of 15x15mm M.S Square tube, the entire door frame to be reinforced with 19x19mm M.S Square tube of 19 gauge. The door frame to be fixed to the wall using M.S. Screws of 65/80mm size complete as per manufacturers specification & direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground without blasting for all works other than foundation in Ordinary/ Soft rock & depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools , In Ordinary/Soft rock upto 300 mm depth

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and fixing RCC precast fencing pole of size 0.15mx0.15mx2.0m casted in M 20 with 20mm down size aggregates making holes for drawing barbed wire at 30 cm c/c using 8 mm dia vertical 4 TMT steel rods and 6 mm dia stirups at 15 cm c/c fixed 1.5 m above Ground level using steel moulding , curing , transportation to work spot including excavation in all types of soil, fixing in plain cement concrete M15 using 20 mm downsize aggregate including aligning to plumb and line providing including cost of all materials, labour,usage charges of machinery complete.

Fencing with G.I. barbed wire R.C.C. post placed at required distance, embedded in cement concrete blocks, every 15th post, last but one end post and corner post shall be strutted on both sides and end post one side only, provided with horizontal lines and two diagonals of barbed wire weighing 9.38 kg per 100 m (minimum), between the two posts fitted and fixed with G.I. staples on wooden plugs or G.I. binding wire tied to 6 mm bar nibs fixed while casting the post (cost of R.C.C. posts, struts, earth work and concrete to be paid for separately) :- Payment to be made per metre cost of total length of barbed wire used.
